title: Hospital: earlier discharge and a discharge lounge
question: What could happen if a general hospital moves most discharges to before noon and opens a discharge lounge?

documents.name: 01-operations-proposal.md
documents.content:
# Operations proposal: earlier discharge and a discharge lounge

This is a fictional proposal written for an evaluation. All names, places and figures are invented.

## Proposal

Marlow General Hospital proposes that most patients who are fit to leave are discharged before noon, and that those waiting for transport or medicines wait in a new discharge lounge with 12 chairs, open from 7am to 7pm. The aim is to free beds earlier in the day for patients waiting in the emergency department.

## Today

On an average weekday 41 patients are discharged, and only 9 leave before noon. Patients waiting for medicines wait a median of 3 hours. The emergency department has 18 patients waiting for a bed at 4pm on a typical day.

## Open questions

The proposal does not say how many nurses the lounge would need or who would staff it at weekends.

documents.name: 02-clinical-and-pharmacy-note.md
documents.content:
# Clinical and pharmacy note

This is a fictional note written for an evaluation. All names, places and figures are invented.

## Medicines

A patient may not leave until a pharmacist has signed the medicines review. The pharmacy has four pharmacists on weekdays and one at weekends, and the dispensary opens at 8am.

## Ward rounds

Consultants finish ward rounds between 11am and 1pm on most wards, so an earlier discharge decision would need rounds to start earlier or a junior doctor to authorise discharges.

## Records

Discharge summaries must be sent to the patient's general practice within 24 hours. The ward clerks write most of the letters.

documents.name: 03-community-care-and-transport-note.md
documents.content:
# Community care and patient transport note

This is a fictional note written for an evaluation. All names, places and figures are invented.

## Social care

The county social care team needs 48 hours' notice to arrange a care package at home, so patients who need one cannot be discharged to home earlier than that. The team does not work at weekends.

## Transport

The patient transport service collects patients in pre-booked slots, and 60% of its slots before noon are already taken by dialysis and outpatient trips. The transport service's records show that on an average weekday 33 patients are discharged.

## Patients and families

Families say they cannot always arrive before noon. Carers of patients with dementia asked that a discharge lounge be quiet and have staff who know the patient. A patients' group said patients should not be moved to a lounge while in pain.
